core_normalisation_target.raw_target_note: the target is core-mean v = -u_impact; on these canary cases u_impact = 0.5, so the raw target value is -0.5, which is the number the sealed L1A-2u matrix records; the dimensionless ratio used by the frozen gate and by this screen is -1.0

region_definitions.wall_samples: wall_measure > 0, bilinear cell-velocity sample at wall centroid

frozen_six_gates_source: inherited verbatim from production.impact_initialization_compatibility_audit.INITIAL_ACCEPTANCE; not re-tuned, not relaxed, not re-ordered

global_speed_envelope.measured_from: frozen reference family C0/C1/C2 in L1A-2u, four frozen canary cases

per_candidate_diagnostics: peak open-cell speed and its location (i, j, x, y, sdf/dx, chi)
local CFL metric at the peak cell (component-wise and summed)
cut-cell open-face finite-volume divergence Linf (dimensional and dimensionless)
deep-solid speed, chi >= 0.01 band speed, embedded-wall bilinear normal speed
core-mean normal speed and its relative error against -u_impact
t=0 state hashes (u, v, phi) for exact replay
prespecification_rule: candidate set, family parameters, six frozen gates, envelope constant, targets and verdict vocabulary are fixed before any candidate value is computed; only the declared diagnostics are reported, and no candidate is added, removed or rescaled afterwards

prohibitions.re_tuning_after_results: forbidden; a non-admissible family is reported, never adjusted
prohibitions.trajectories: none; the frozen substep kernel is never constructed by this module
